svg.text: MusicJam · Bounded Contexts & Microservice Architecture · Checkpoint 4
API Gateway separates UI from backend services · Services call each other directly over HTTP (no gateway) · Each service owns its own data
Internal Docker Network — Direct HTTP between Microservices (No API Gateway)
User interactions, QR join & host playback
Browser state: userId cookie & localStorage name
Loads & plays video on host device
Provides playback end & embed error events
Forwards Host & X-Forwarded-Host headers for LAN QR code URLs
Fetches verified metadata from Search Catalog
Failure degrades to host review in Core
